definitions.full: H5480. cuwk I. [ סִיךְ סוּךְ, verb pour in anointing, anoint (Late Hebrew Aramaic סוּךְ anoint ); — Qal Perfect 2feminine singular וָסַכְתְּ consecutive Ruth 3:3 ; 1 singular סָ֑כְתִּי Dan 10:3 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תָּסוּךְ Deut 28:40 ; Micah 6:15 ; 2 feminine singular תָּסוּכִי 2Sam 14:2 ; 1 singular suffix וָאֲסֻכֵֿךְ Ezek 16:9 ; 3 masculine plural suffix וַיְסֻכוּם 2Chr 28:15 ; also (probably) 3 masculine singular וַ֫יָּסֶךְ 2Sam 12:20 (Ges § 73f .); Infinitive absolute סוֺךְ Dan 10:3 ; apparently Imperfect passive is יִיסָ֔ךְ read יוסך Samaritan, compare Kö i. 436 (and not Hoph`al , compare Ges l.c .); — anoint , in the toilet, often after washing; usually 1 reflexive anoint oneself , 2Sam 12:20 ; Ruth 3:3 , לֹאסָֿ֑כְתִּי סוֺךְ Dan 10:3 ; + שֶׁמֶן as accusative of material 2Sam 14:2 ; Micah 6:15 ; Deut 28:40 . 2 active, anoint another Ezek 16:9 ( בַּשֶּׁמֶן ), 2Chr 28:15 . 3 passive, be poured , Exod 30:32 (P; subject the sacred oil).
